mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, request_no, customer_id, applicant_user_id, applicant_team_id, requested_fields_json, approved_fields_json, reason, status, assigned_approver_id, approver_source, requested_duration_minutes, approved_duration_minutes, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_reason, grant_starts_at, grant_expires_at, revoked_by, revoked_at, revoke_reason, reveal_count, last_revealed_at, created_at, updated_at, version

SELECT r.id, r.request_no AS requestNo, r.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_no AS customerNo, COALESCE(c.display_name, c.nickname, c.customer_no) AS customerName, r.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, app.display_name AS applicantName, r.applicant_team_id AS applicantTeamId, r.requested_fields_json AS requestedFieldsJson, r.approved_fields_json AS approvedFieldsJson, r.reason, r.status, r.assigned_approver_id AS assignedApproverId, approver.display_name AS assignedApproverName, r.approver_source AS approverSource, r.requested_duration_minutes AS requestedDurationMinutes, r.approved_duration_minutes AS approvedDurationMinutes, r.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, reviewer.display_name AS reviewedByName, r.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, r.review_reason AS reviewReason, r.grant_starts_at AS grantStartsAt, r.grant_expires_at AS grantExpiresAt, r.revoked_by AS revokedBy, revoker.display_name AS revokedByName, r.revoked_at AS revokedAt, r.revoke_reason AS revokeReason, r.reveal_count AS revealCount, r.last_revealed_at AS lastRevealedAt, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.version FROM crm_customer_privacy_request r INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND c.id = r.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user app ON app.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND app.id = r.applicant_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user approver ON approver.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND approver.id = r.assigned_approver_id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON reviewer.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND reviewer.id = r.reviewed_by LEFT JOIN sys_user revoker ON revoker.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND revoker.id = r.revoked_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_customer_privacy_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer_privacy_request SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_fields_json = #{approvedFieldsJson}, approved_duration_minutes = #{approvedDurationMinutes}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_reason = #{reviewReason}, grant_starts_at = #{grantStartsAt}, grant_expires_at = #{grantExpiresAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_customer_privacy_request r INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND c.id = r.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user app ON app.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND app.id = r.applicant_user_id

SELECT l.id, l.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_no AS customerNo, COALESCE(c.display_name, c.nickname, c.customer_no) AS customerName, l.actor_user_id AS actorUserId, u.username AS actorUsername, u.display_name AS actorDisplayName, l.actor_role_snapshot AS actorRoleSnapshot, l.access_mode AS accessMode, l.request_id AS requestId, req.request_no AS requestNo, l.revealed_fields_json AS revealedFieldsJson, l.masked_values_snapshot_json AS maskedValuesSnapshotJson, l.reason, l.client_ip AS clientIp, l.user_agent AS userAgent, l.trace_id AS traceId, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM crm_customer_privacy_access_log l INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND c.id = l.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND u.id = l.actor_user_id LEFT JOIN crm_customer_privacy_request req ON req.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND req.id = l.request_id
ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
